study_design: Survey-based observational study of men from BRCA mutation families; the abstract does not clearly establish the exact case-control sampling structure.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: We examined prostate cancer risk factors in 74 men who were part of families with a BRCA mutation.
reason: The study examined general prostate cancer risk factors among BRCA carriers. No stage, grade, advanced, metastatic, high-risk, or lethal incident prostate cancer endpoint is reported.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Therefore, this study aimed to identify modifiable risk factors for prostate cancer in BRCA carriers. We examined prostate cancer risk factors in 74 men who were part of families with a BRCA mutation. This study examined nine dichotomous variables including: exercise, history of vasectomy, smoking history, alcohol use, finasteride use, statin use, aspirin use, coffee use, and vitamin use.
estimate_classifications.reason: Alcohol was examined as a risk factor for prostate cancer generally. The abstract provides no aggressive endpoint and no alcohol-specific effect estimate with a 95% confidence interval.
